newsitem.title: USA: Comcast to launch digital TV in Calif..
newsitem.headline: Comcast to launch digital TV in Calif..

text.p: Comcast Corp on Thursday said it will launch a digital television service for its current cable TV subscribers in Orange County, California beginning in May.

The service will be launched to 11,000 homes in the city of Buena Park and eventually spread to some 85,000 subscribers in nearby Fullerton, Newport Beach, Placentia, Seal Beach and Santa Ana. All are located just south of Los Angeles.
Priced "a few dollars" above the company's current premium service and offer 150 channels, a sharper picture, CD-quality sound, music channels and premium and pay-per-view channels.

Comcast's cable provider in Orange County, Comcast Cablevision, offers its basic package plus one premium channel for $43.99 per month. For subscribers wanting its full premium service, the price is $59.99.
To offer the advanced digital service, Comcast said it has laid more than 1,800 miles of fiber-optic cable in the county, but a spokesman declined to say how much it cost to do so.

Comcast will offer an Internet service for computers, called Comcast@Home, soon after the digital TV launch. That service will provide 24-hour Net access and digital downloads at 100 times the speed of a standard 28.8 kbps modem.
